articles.summary: Single-family homes from the mid $200s offer up to 5 bedrooms and 2,180 square feet, with quartz countertops included and easy access to I-26 KEY TAKEAWAYS New construction homes in Clinton: Century Complete is planning 139 single-family homesites at Shell Creek Manor, with homes starting from the mid $200s. Flexible floor plans: Five single-family floor plans from 1,290 to 2,180 square feet, with 3 to 5 bedrooms, 2 to 3 bathrooms and 2-car garages. Built-in style: Every home at Shell Creek Manor features an open-concept layout with stylish features like quartz countertops and luxury vinyl-plank flooring. Convenient location: Shell Creek Manor offers easy access to Interstate 26 and boasts efficient commutes to Spartanburg, Greenville, and Columbia. Virtual Insider Event: This 30-minute online event is planned for Monday, Nov. 9 at 5:30 p.m. Attendees will find out more about homesite releases and Grand Opening incentives. articles.summary: Century Communities, Inc. (NYSE: CCS), one of the nation's largest homebuilders, today announced that its Board of Directors has declared a quarterly cash dividend of $0.32 per share. This dividend is payable on December 9, 2026 to stockholders of record as of the close of business on November 25, 2026. About Century Communities: Century Communities, Inc. (NYSE: CCS) is one of the nation's largest homebuilders and a recognized industry leader in online home sales. Newsweek has named the Company one of America's Most Trustworthy Companies for four consecutive years. Century Communities has also been designated as one of U.S. News World Report's Best Companies to Work For (2025–2026). Through its Century Communities and Century Complete brands, Century's mission is to build attractive, high-quality homes at affordable prices to provide its valued customers with A HOME FOR EVERY DREAM ® .
